name: plates-2017
notes: For data taken on the MCP plates fitted on 2017-03-17, until the 2022 swap. For now it holds matlab-2019's constants, so its hits are matlab-2019's, written under its own file names; it changes only when these plates are calibrated. A plot's settings suggest it for a folder dated while its plates were in, but never pick it for you. Not calibrated yet: the 2019–2021 halo runs are to calibrate it.
